issues.description: The UML in the problem statement marks Farm.addAnimal(...) with a '-' (private) visibility, while the template and solution expect a publicly accessible addAnimal method (the solution implements public void addAnimal(Animal)). If a student follows the UML literally and implements addAnimal as private, they would be unable to add animals from Main or other classes and be confused about intended accessibility.
issues.suggestedFix: Correct the UML / problem statement to show addAnimal(Animal) as public (use '+' instead of '-') or explicitly state in the text that addAnimal should be public so students implement it with public visibility. This aligns the UML with the template and solution and prevents confusion about how to add animals to the Farm.
